title: plan_approval=operator full-PRD approval gate (consumes the CAM-153 operator-decision gate primitive)
description:
Split from CAM-153 (CAM-117 Half B/B-2), item 4 of the original gates cluster. Consumes the generic operator-decision gate primitive + `cam decide` shipped by CAM-153. DEPENDS ON CAM-153 — set blockedBy:[CAM-153] at spec time.

Current state (PARTIAL, 'Half A' scope): on auditor APPROVE in plan_approval=operator mode the plan-runner pauses via phase:awaiting-operator (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts handleAuditApproved ~:1274, sidecar exitPhaseAfterPlan ~:1966) but it is a DEAD-END — no full-PRD presentation, no approve/reject options, no resume path. The plan_approval config key + readPlanApproval accessor already exist (default 'auto', src/config/models.ts:274-289) and are surfaced in the Setup/Config TUIs, so there is NO new config work.

Grilled design to implement (2026-07-15, operator-approved full-cluster):
- On auditor APPROVE + plan_approval=operator: write an operator-decision gate (gate='plan-approval', options=[approve, reject]) whose context is a summary of the generated prd.json (title + story list + acceptance-criteria counts). Pause.
- `cam decide approve` -> run the existing runPostAuditAction path (commit PRD + create branch + flip phase:implementing).
- `cam decide reject` -> discard the generated prd.json + phase:idle + notify.
- Deliberate behavior change: the operator reviews the FULL audited PRD, not a pre-PRD sketch.

Before speccing, re-measure blast radius with an Explore fan-out — the primitive's final code shape will drift during CAM-153 implementation.
